content:
Day One: Arrive in Tokyo. Thou shalt lodge in a ryokan near Shinjuku. Thou shalt wander the neon streets of Shibuya. Thou shalt taste sushi at a modest stall. Thou shalt ascend the Tokyo Tower at dusk.  
Day Two: Travel to Kyoto by the swift Shinkansen. Thou shalt visit the golden Kinkakuji. Thou shalt stroll the Philosopher's Path. Thou shalt partake in tea ceremony within a ancient machiya. Thou shalt pray at Fushimi Inari shrine where myriad torii gates doth ascend the hill.  
Day Three: Explore Nara. Thou shalt feed the gentle deer in Nara Park. Thou shalt behold the great Buddha at Todai-ji. Thou shalt wander the lantern lit streets of Kasuga Taisha. Thou shalt return to Kyoto for evening repose.  
Day Four: Journey to Osaka. Thou shalt indulge in takoyaki upon Dotonbori canal. Thou shalt explore Osaka Castle and its verdant gardens. Thou shalt experience the lively Kuromon Ichiba market. Thou shalt ascend the Umeda Sky Bridge for night view.  
Day Five: Return to Tokyo. Thou shalt visit the Meiji Shrine amidst the forest. Thou shalt shop in Harajuku for quaint fashion. Thou shalt enjoy a final ramen bowl in Ikebukuro. Thou shalt depart with memories as rich as sakura blossoms.
